title: 2019-20 Panini Mosaic - Reactive Orange Prizm #129 Daniel Theis Boston Celtics
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2019-20 Panini Mosaic sports trading card featuring Daniel Theis of the Boston Celtics. The card is part of the Reactive Orange Prizm parallel/variety and is numbered 129 in the set. It is a great addition to any collection for fans of basketball and the National Basketball Association (NBA). The card is manufactured by Panini and is part of the base set. It is not autographed and is a single card. Get this card now for your collection!
